fx-bars.description: An equalizer of four scaled bars.

fx-caret-dot.description: A pulsing dot at the end of a streaming answer.

fx-ellipsis.description: Appends dots that count up to three: “Thinking...”.

fx-msg.description: A small rise and scale for a message.
fx-msg.html: Hi! How can I help today?

fx-msg-user.description: A diagonal scale entrance for a user message.

fx-shimmer.description: Sweep a highlight across a skeleton.

fx-shimmer-text.description: A highlight sweeps through the text itself, for “Thinking…” labels.

fx-skeleton-msg.description: A skeleton message with three lines of varied width and a travelling highlight.

fx-step.description: A tool or agent step in progress: spinner icon before the label. Swap for fx-step-done or fx-step-error.

fx-step-done.description: A finished step: a checkmark pops in before the label. Set --fx-success to color it.

fx-step-error.description: A failed step: a cross pops in before the label. Set --fx-danger to color it.

fx-stream-word.description: A streamed word or token fades and comes into focus. Apply to each appended span.
fx-stream-word.html: Streaming one word at a time

fx-typing.description: A complete typing bubble: a bright dot hops across three dim dots. No child markup.

fx-bars-travel.description: An opacity highlight travels through five bars.

fx-bars-wave.description: Five bars rise and fall with offset phases.

fx-comet.description: Send a fading streak across its track.

fx-dots-orbit.description: Three dots physically orbit their center.

fx-dual-ring.description: Two concentric arcs rotate in opposite directions.

fx-fill.description: Sweep, hold, and fade a tint.

fx-ring-pulse.description: An outlined ring expands and fades.

fx-scan.description: Sweep a narrow beam back and forth.

fx-skeleton-wave.description: An angled highlight travels across a skeleton block.

fx-sonar.description: Two expanding rings ripple with offset phases.

fx-trace.description: Draw a line across its track.

fx-clip.description: Clip overflowing roll or drawer effects.

fx-cycle-2.description: Rotate 2 decorative status labels in a shared grid.

fx-cycle-3.description: Rotate 3 decorative status labels in a shared grid.

fx-cycle-4.description: Rotate 4 decorative status labels in a shared grid.

fx-cycle-5.description: Rotate 5 decorative status labels in a shared grid.

fx-roll-down-out.description: roll down dismissal; the application owns DOM removal.

fx-roll-up-out.description: roll up dismissal; the application owns DOM removal.

fx-down-left.description: Fade in from the lower-left corner.

fx-down-right.description: Fade in from the lower-right corner.

fx-grow-x.description: Grow visually on the horizontal axis; surrounding layout does not move.

fx-pop.description: Scale in with a spring easing.

fx-reveal.description: Unmask from the top and fade in.

fx-sheet-left.description: Slide a drawer in from the left.

fx-sheet-right.description: Slide a drawer in from the right.

fx-spring-down.description: Drop with a small overshoot and settle.

fx-spring-up.description: Rise with a small overshoot and settle.

fx-up-left.description: Fade in from the upper-left corner.

fx-up-right.description: Fade in from the upper-right corner.

fx-wipe.description: Unmask from the left and fade in.

fx-zoom-left.description: Scale in with a short move from the left.

fx-zoom-right.description: Scale in with a short move from the right.

fx-blur-out.description: blur dismissal; the application owns DOM removal.

fx-down-out.description: down dismissal; the application owns DOM removal.

fx-drop-out.description: drop dismissal; the application owns DOM removal.

fx-fade-out.description: fade dismissal; the application owns DOM removal.

fx-flip-x-out.description: flip x dismissal; the application owns DOM removal.

fx-left-out.description: left dismissal; the application owns DOM removal.

fx-pop-out.description: pop dismissal; the application owns DOM removal.

fx-right-out.description: Dismiss to the right; alias of fx-slide-out.

fx-roll-out.description: Roll away to the right with a fade.

fx-rotate-out.description: rotate dismissal; the application owns DOM removal.

fx-sheet-left-out.description: Dismiss a drawer to the left.

fx-sheet-out.description: sheet dismissal; the application owns DOM removal.

fx-sheet-right-out.description: Dismiss a drawer to the right.

fx-sheet-up-out.description: Dismiss a drawer through its top edge.

fx-slide-out.description: slide dismissal; the application owns DOM removal.

fx-swing-out.description: Hinge away from the top edge.

fx-up-out.description: up dismissal; the application owns DOM removal.

fx-zoom-out.description: zoom dismissal; the application owns DOM removal.

fx-nod.description: Two small vertical movements for acknowledgment.

fx-recoil.description: Compress backward, then recover with an overshoot.

fx-wobble.description: Sideways travel coupled with a diminishing rotation.

fx-stagger.description: Stagger child entrances; use fx-stagger on the parent.

fx-stagger-blur.description: Stagger child entrances with the blur variant; use fx-stagger on the parent.

fx-stagger-down.description: Children enter from above in sequence.

fx-stagger-fade.description: Stagger child entrances with the fade variant; use fx-stagger on the parent.

fx-stagger-left.description: Stagger child entrances with the left variant; use fx-stagger on the parent.

fx-stagger-pop.description: Stagger child entrances with the pop variant; use fx-stagger on the parent.

fx-stagger-right.description: Stagger child entrances with the right variant; use fx-stagger on the parent.

fx-stagger-roll-up.description: Children roll upward in sequence; clip overflow where needed.

fx-stagger-rotate.description: Children tilt into place in sequence.

fx-stagger-zoom.description: Children scale in gently in sequence.

fx-fill-h-down.description: Sweep a background tint up from the bottom.

fx-fill-h-left.description: Sweep a background tint in from the left.

fx-fill-h-right.description: Sweep a background tint in from the right.

fx-fill-h-up.description: Sweep a background tint down from the top.

fx-glow-h.description: Add a glow on hover or focus.

fx-grow.description: Grow slightly on hover or focus.

fx-lift.description: Lift and add a shadow on hover or focus.

fx-overline.description: Reveal a stroke above the label.

fx-rotate-h.description: Rotate and scale on hover or focus.

fx-shine.description: Sweep a highlight across the surface.

fx-tilt.description: Tilt in perspective on hover or focus.

fx-underline.description: Reveal an underline from the left.

fx-underline-center.description: Reveal an underline outward from its center.

fx-underline-right.description: Reveal an underline from the right.

fx-collapse-h.description: Collapse the maximum height; this changes layout.

fx-collapse-w.description: Collapse the maximum width; this changes layout.

fx-expand-h.description: Expand the maximum height; this changes layout.

fx-expand-w.description: Expand the maximum width; this changes layout.

fx-grow-x-to.description: Grow visually on the horizontal axis and hold the configured scale; surrounding layout does not move.

fx-grow-y.description: Grow visually on the vertical axis; surrounding layout does not move.

fx-shrink-x.description: Shrink visually on the horizontal axis; surrounding layout does not move.

fx-shrink-x-to.description: Shrink visually on the horizontal axis and hold the configured scale; surrounding layout does not move.

fx-shrink-y.description: Shrink visually on the vertical axis; surrounding layout does not move.

fx-blur-zoom-in.description: Scale up through a soft focus pull.

fx-iris-in.description: Open a circular mask around a configurable origin.

fx-iris-out.description: Close a circular mask around a configurable origin.

fx-wipe-down.description: Unmask from the bottom without fading.

fx-wipe-left.description: Unmask from the left without fading.

fx-wipe-right.description: Unmask from the right without fading.

fx-wipe-up.description: Unmask from the top without fading.
